tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Page background. White in light mode, as the brand asks.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sidebar, dialogs, table body.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Table header, stripes, hover rows, input fills.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Tracks behind meters, inset panels, code and ID chips.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Card and table dividers. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Edges of inputs, selects and checkboxes (3:1 against surface).

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Body text and headings on bg and surface.

tokens.name: text-muted
tokens.usage: Labels, captions, helper text. Passes 4.5:1 on surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Tea green. Primary buttons, links, active nav, focus ring, key chart series.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of primary.

tokens.name: primary-strong
tokens.usage: Deep green for headings in brand moments and text on primary-soft.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, selected row, soft badges.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary fills.

tokens.name: bud
tokens.usage: Bud green from the logo. Decorative accents and the meter fill only; never text.

tokens.name: success-fg
tokens.usage: Approved, paid, quality on target. Text on success-bg.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background of success badges and alerts.

tokens.name: warning-fg
tokens.usage: Pending, syncing, below quality target. Text on warning-bg.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background of warning badges and alerts.

tokens.name: danger-fg
tokens.usage: Disputes, errors, rejected entries. Text on danger-bg.

tokens.name: danger-bg
tokens.usage: Background of danger badges and alerts.

tokens.name: info-fg
tokens.usage: Neutral information, offline notices. Text on info-bg.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Background of info badges and alerts.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px focus ring on every interactive element.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default web app text and table cells.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, button text at small size, table headers.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase group labels in the sidebar and stat cards.

styles.name: number
styles.usage: Big figures in stat cards. Always tabular numbers.

styles.name: id
styles.usage: Platform IDs and grower numbers, e.g. TLF-KCO-FMR-0004817.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-text gap, badge padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside controls and between tight items.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input padding, table cell padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile, gap between form fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding on web, gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Gap between page sections.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page top padding, empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, ID chips, checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, nav items.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, dialogs, the sidebar logo tile.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Theme toggle, meters, avatar chips.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Drawers, dropdowns, dialogs.
